title: Command API
what: The words of the bmo-job binary: serve, which runs the service by its settings; mcp, which serves the harness plugin; and openapi, which prints the document, as the command document states them.

title: Rust client
what: The published crate bmo-job-client: every body as a type, every route as a call of JobClient, the event stream, and the webhook signature, as the API document states them.

title: HTTP API
what: The routes the service serves over HTTP, with their bodies, pages, event stream and refusal codes, as the API document and the OpenAPI document state them.

title: Harness plugin
what: The bmo-job plugin: the MCP server bmo-job mcp, its eighteen tools over the client, and the skill telling a harness when to use them, as the API document states them.

title: TypeScript client
what: The bmo-job-client package in package/: the types generated from the OpenAPI document and jobClient over them, each call one route, as the API document states them.
